title: Starfield and Starfield Creation Kit
target_role: First Skyrim VR-quality proving project and Creation Engine 2 authoring evidence layer

canonical_sources.claim: The Starfield Creation Kit is a separate free Steam download.
The editor will not launch unless Starfield is owned and installed through Steam.
Canonical Starfield Creation Kit documentation surface.
Official game and Creation Kit compatibility/change evidence.

version_policy: Do not infer a current game or editor version from public pages. Capture the exact installed Battle Bridge versions and SHA-256 hashes before research or proof.

licence_and_rights.posture: Proprietary Bethesda game and editor; documentation and individual files may have separate terms.
licence_and_rights.ingestion: Metadata, hashes, inventories, derived schemas, independently written notes and bounded operational evidence only.
forbidden_repository_content: Bethesda textures, meshes, audio, video or other assets

evidence_planes.authoring: Creation Kit records, forms, objects, relationships, scripts, plugin structure and official documentation.
evidence_planes.implementation: Admitted public VR code including Mutar/NoMoreFlat, REFramework and OpenXR sources.
evidence_planes.runtime: Exact Battle Bridge Starfield build, editor build, configuration, logs, captures and headset results.

required_fields: Creation Kit presence, install path, version and SHA-256
Steam ownership and launch compatibility verdict
active plugin, master and archive metadata

promotion_rule: Keep authored, implementation and observed-runtime evidence distinct. Promote only evidence-linked derived knowledge, never proprietary assets.
